title: Output of Email Provider Detector
description: One row per domain in the default dataset (invalid, nonexistent and failed domains included as free rows with status and error); a run summary in the OUTPUT record.

results.title: Domains
results.description: One row per domain. Example: {"domain":"hubspot.com","status":"ok","espMatch":"google","mailboxProvider":"Google Workspace","secureEmailGateway":null,"emailSecurityGrade":"A","sendingServices":["Google Workspace","HubSpot"]}. Failed: {"domain":"nope.invalid","status":"nxdomain","error":"…"}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: domainsRequested, domainsChecked, byStatus, byEspMatch (google/microsoft/other/none counts), chargeLimitReached, zeroResultsReason, nextSteps.
